# Latetwenties

> Latetwenties is a small Auckland marketing agency. We help local service
> businesses across New Zealand and Australia get found online and chosen by
> local customers. We treat the website, the Google Business Profile, the
> listings, the reviews and the advertising as one connected system, and we
> treat the business owner like a person, not a dashboard.

Founder: Brendan MacDonald
Based: Auckland, New Zealand
Working: New Zealand and Australia
Email: team@latetwenties.agency
Phone: +64-9-884-4418
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm NZT
Website: https://latetwenties.agency

## What we do

One system, three parts: the Found & Chosen System. Run one or all three.
Fixed pricing, no lock-ins.

- **Get Found**: a one-time build covering the website, Google Business
  Profile, local listings, SEO and AI-search foundations, and review
  systems. Two to four weeks, end to end. One fixed price, and it is yours
  to keep when it's done.
- **Stay Chosen**: the ongoing care that moves you up the list over months.
  Google Business Profile posts, review generation, listings monitoring,
  iterative SEO, and a regular plain-language update on what's working.
  Fixed monthly, month-to-month, no lock-ins.
- **Ring This Week**: paid campaigns on Google and Meta for enquiries now,
  not next quarter. Campaigns pointed at the jobs you actually want, ads
  that sound like you, landing pages ready for the click, and conversion
  tracking that counts real enquiries. Your ad budget plus a fixed monthly
  management fee. On when you want it, off when you don't.

The guarantee: run the full 90 days with us (the build plus your first
three months of Stay Chosen) and if you don't have more enquiries than the
90 days before us, we keep working free until you do.

## Who we work with

Local service businesses, owner-led, close to the work. Builders,
concreters, electricians, plumbers, landscapers, mobile mechanics, physios,
dentists, allied health practitioners, bookkeepers, accountants, lawyers in
their own practice, cleaners, tutors, family businesses. Anyone whose
customers search "near me" or their suburb name.

The market we serve sits between "established" and "can't yet afford one of
the big agencies."

## Frequently asked

**How long does Get Found take?** Two to four weeks, end to end. Week one
is research; weeks two and three are the build; week four is launch and
handover.

**When should Stay Chosen start?** Whenever you're ready. Most clients
pick it up the week Get Found goes live so the signals get worked while
the build is fresh in Google's eyes.

**Can I run Ring This Week on its own?** Yes. Each part works on its own
and they're stronger together. Some clients come with a site they're happy
with and want the ads only.

**Do you work outside Auckland?** Yes, across New Zealand and Australia.
Most of what we do is remote. The location of your customers matters more
than yours.

**What if I already have a website?** We'll look before recommending
anything. Sometimes it's a rebuild, sometimes it's leave-it-alone and
focus on Stay Chosen or Ring This Week. We'll tell you straight.

**Do I own everything?** Yes. Website, domain, Google Business Profile,
every account we set up, all in your name.

**Why not hourly rates?** Hourly rewards slow work. Fixed pricing rewards
getting the work done properly.

**What if it's not working?** Then we keep working, free, until the
90-day guarantee is met. No lock-in either way.

## How we work

Manaakitanga is the operating value. A Māori value about how people care
for each other. Mana (a person's standing, dignity, spirit) joined with aki
(to uplift or support). It's about the owner across the table, not the
business in front of them. We listen properly. We carry your reputation
with the same care you would. The work follows from that.

We aim to be the marketing partner you forget about, in the good way. We do
the work, we show our working, and we only pull you in when we genuinely
need a decision only you can make. Each month you get a single page or a
short Loom: what's been done, what's changed, what's next.

## Voice

Plain-spoken, NZ-grounded. No hype, no jargon, no marketing fluff. We treat
your business with the same seriousness you treat it yourself. Honest about
what's working and what isn't. Wins celebrated. Bits that aren't landing
said out loud, not hidden under a softer chart.

## What we don't do

- Lock-in contracts
- Hourly billing
- Suburb-specific landing pages designed only for SEO
- Pitch decks and wireframe sign-offs before a build
- Stock photography on case studies
- Composite or anonymous "results"
- Vague reporting that hides what isn't working
